changelog: Merged the upstream 1.1.8 release: Connect to PC (pair the phone with VS Code on your PC and use the same chats live on both), folder tabs in Files, Claude Code subagents in the side bar, OpenCode questions and model visibility fixes, WebView DevTools and network logging, and a reliable local server restart
Fixed custom MCP servers (like Google Flow MCP) failing with 'initialize rejected by transport': MCP startup now uses the app's own ports and package paths instead of the original AntiGem's
Fixed Codex not downloading: the Codex installer now resolves the right binary paths and download location inside AntiGem+
Fixed 'failed to connect to AGI hub (Expected gRPC but was 404)' when running the agent on the cloud
